require "digest"
require "fileutils"
require "json"
require "open3"
require "yaml"

workflow = "/qa/validation.yml"
step = YAML.load_file(workflow).dig("jobs", "legacy", "steps").find { |entry| entry.fetch("run", "").include?("legacy_args=(") }
command = step.fetch("run")
tail = 'bundle exec rspec "${legacy_args[@]}"' + "\n"
raise "Unexpected final command" unless command.end_with?(tail)
# Execute the exact workflow preflight; full business execution is intentionally omitted.
preflight = command.delete_suffix(tail)
originals = %w[spec/day2/fault_process_spec.rb spec/reportportal_cucumber/cucumber/world_spec.rb spec/reportportal_cucumber/cucumber/m4a_public_delivery_integration_spec.rb]
drivers = %w[.ci-driver/spec/fixtures/legacy_fault_process.rb .ci-driver/spec/fixtures/legacy_portability_specs.rb]
correct = "spec/{#{originals.map { |path| path.delete_prefix('spec/') }.join(',')}}"
broken = "{#{originals.join(',')}}"
raise "Missing exact workflow pattern" unless preflight.scan(correct).length == 1
world_descriptions = File.read("/qa/source/#{originals[1]}").scan(/^  it "([^"]+)"/).flatten
m4a_descriptions = File.read("/qa/source/#{originals[2]}").scan(/^  it "([^"]+)"/).flatten
fault_descriptions = [400, 401].product([false, true]).map do |status, strict|
  "preserves original native business failure under HTTP #{status}, strict=#{strict}"
end + [
  "handles real SIGINT in a Cucumber subprocess with a bounded exit and an honest receipt",
  "does not replace a business failure with final metadata outage",
  "bounds the whole native finalization with slow HTTP instead of one budget per request"
]
expected = { originals[1] => world_descriptions, originals[2] => m4a_descriptions, drivers.first => fault_descriptions }
results = {}
{ "correct" => preflight, "broken" => preflight.sub(correct, broken) }.each do |variant, script|
  directory = "/qa/evidence/discovery-#{ARGV.fetch(0)}-#{variant}"
  FileUtils.mkdir_p(directory)
  audit_path = File.join(directory, "audit.json")
  env = { "RUNNER_TEMP" => directory, "LEGACY_SOURCE_ROOT" => "/qa/source",
          "DISCOVERY_AUDIT_PATH" => audit_path, "RUBYOPT" => "-r/qa/discovery_audit.rb" }
  stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(env, "/bin/bash", "-e", "-o", "pipefail", "-c", script, chdir: "/qa/source")
  File.write(File.join(directory, "stdout.log"), stdout)
  File.write(File.join(directory, "stderr.log"), stderr)
  report = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(directory, "legacy-discovery.json")))
  audit = JSON.parse(File.read(audit_path))
  files = audit.fetch("files_to_run").map { |path| path.delete_prefix("/qa/source/") }
  examples = report.fetch("examples")
  by_file = examples.group_by { |entry| entry.fetch("file_path").delete_prefix("./") }
  protected = expected.to_h do |relative, descriptions|
    actual = by_file.fetch(relative, []).map { |entry| entry.fetch("description") }
    if variant == "correct"
      raise "Protected case mismatch #{relative}" unless actual.sort == descriptions.sort && actual.uniq == actual
    end
    [relative, actual]
  end
  if variant == "correct"
    raise "Correct preflight failed #{stderr}" unless status.success?
    raise "Original selected" unless (files & originals).empty?
    raise "Drivers missing or repeated" unless drivers.all? { |path| files.count(path) == 1 }
    raise "Original fault cases registered" unless by_file.fetch(originals.first, []).empty?
    raise "Expected 889 unique cases" unless examples.length == 889 && examples.map { |entry| entry.fetch("id") }.uniq.length == 889
  else
    raise "Broken pattern not rejected" unless status.exitstatus == 1 && examples.length == 905 && (files & originals).sort == originals.sort
    raise "Wrong rejection reason" unless stderr.include?("exactly 889 unique examples")
  end
  results[variant] = {
    exit: status.exitstatus, command: script, stdout: stdout, stderr: stderr,
    summary: report.fetch("summary"), unique_ids: examples.map { |entry| entry.fetch("id") }.uniq.length,
    ruby: audit.fetch("ruby"), cucumber: audit.fetch("cucumber"),
    files_to_run: files, selected_originals: files & originals,
    protected_descriptions: protected, original_fault_registered: by_file.fetch(originals.first, []).length,
    report_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(directory, "legacy-discovery.json")).hexdigest,
    report: File.join(directory, "legacy-discovery.json"), audit: audit_path
  }
end
output = "/qa/evidence/discovery-#{ARGV.fetch(0)}-verified.json"
File.write(output, JSON.pretty_generate(results) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(results.transform_values { |value| value.slice(:ruby, :cucumber, :exit, :summary, :unique_ids, :selected_originals, :original_fault_registered) })
observation_audit_script:
at_exit do
  if defined?(RSpec::Core) && ENV["DISCOVERY_AUDIT_PATH"]
    require "json"
    File.write(ENV.fetch("DISCOVERY_AUDIT_PATH"), JSON.pretty_generate(
      ruby: RUBY_VERSION, cucumber: Gem.loaded_specs.fetch("cucumber").version.to_s,
      files_to_run: RSpec.configuration.files_to_run,
      examples: RSpec.world.all_examples.map { |example| example.metadata.slice(:file_path, :description, :full_description, :line_number) }
    ))
  end
end
limitations: Actual Linux aarch64 Ruby 3.1.7 and 3.3.12; remote uses x86_64 and Ruby 3.3.13.

Baseline discovery executes the exact workflow array and JSON validator, with only the final full RSpec execution deliberately omitted. All 889 examples are registered, not executed as business tests.
An observation-only RUBYOPT at_exit hook records RSpec files_to_run and metadata without changing selection or fixtures.
Private bundles contain the real baseline SDK/Cucumber/RSpec/WebMock plus Rake/Sinatra/Rantly needed for discovery, not the full remote lock graph.
No production or existing driver changes, SDK rebuild, Git write, third push or remote success is claimed by this QA evidence.
